summary: Brera Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K providing an update on the expected timing of its previously approved 1-for-10 reverse share split, effective on or about May 14, 2026, subject to Nasdaq processing. The split consolidates 83,874,383 Class B ordinary shares into 8,387,438 shares, with no change in trading symbol (SLMT). The board approved the split on May 1, 2026, following shareholder approval on April 7, 2026, to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation.
